title: Changing school

intro.bo: {nome}, a new school is a bit scary even for grown-ups. Let's see what we can do.
intro.pilu: Changing school, {nome}: everything's new, but you're still you. Let's look at the situations.
intro.tango: New school, {nome}! I'd just run straight in. But maybe there's a better way.

offscreen: Make a list together of three things that stay the same (old friends, sport, home).

scenes.text: New school. Everyone already knows each other, and you don't know anyone.

options.label: I introduce myself to whoever is next to me
options.outcome: The child sitting next to you shows you where things are.

options.label: I wait a few days
options.outcome: That's fine: after three days you already know who plays what.

options.label: I ask the teacher to introduce me
options.outcome: The teacher does, and gives you a buddy to show you around.

scenes.text: Here they do something you didn't do at your old school.

options.label: I say I've never done it
options.outcome: The teacher says: no problem, I'll explain it to you.

options.label: I copy the others
options.outcome: It half works. In the end you ask.

options.label: I tell them at home
options.outcome: You talk about it at home, and the next day you ask more calmly.

outro.bo: We did it, {nome}. I got a bit scared, but it worked out.
outro.pilu: Well done, {nome}, you looked carefully. That's enough for today.
outro.tango: Done! {nome}, tomorrow we'll do another one. Now I'm off running.
